LESSON: POLITE LANGUAGE

Grade: PP1
Subject: LANGUAGE ACTIVITIES
Strand: Strand 2
Topic 2.3: Polite language

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Polite language. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. Use appropriate vocabulary when making requests at home and at school.
2. Use appropriate vocabulary when appreciating others at home and at school.
3. Experience pleasure in making requests at home and at school.
4. Take pleasure in appreciating others when need arises. play making requests and appreciating others. deliberately model the habit of making requests and appreciating others as need arises. encouraged to make requests and appreciate others during 15 relevant situations in school and at home. clips on request and appreciation and be guided to imitate making requests and appreciation. Core-competence developed: Digital literacy, communication and collaboration,

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. Use appropriate vocabulary when making requests at home and at school.
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to use appropriate vocabulary when making requests at home and at school. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

2. Use appropriate vocabulary when appreciating others at home and at school.
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to use appropriate vocabulary when appreciating others at home and at school. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

3. Experience pleasure in making requests at home and at school.
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to experience pleasure in making requests at home and at school. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

4. Take pleasure in appreciating others when need arises. play making requests and appreciating others. deliberately model the habit of making requests and appreciating others as need arises. encouraged to make requests and appreciate others during 15 relevant situations in school and at home. clips on request and appreciation and be guided to imitate making requests and appreciation. Core-competence developed: Digital literacy, communication and collaboration,
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to take pleasure in appreciating others when need arises. play making requests and appreciating others. deliberately model the habit of making requests and appreciating others as need arises. encouraged to make requests and appreciate others during 15 relevant situations in school and at home. clips on request and appreciation and be guided to imitate making requests and appreciation. Core-competence developed: Digital literacy, communication and collaboration,. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: When you meet your teacher in the morning, say “Good morning” clearly and smile.

Example 2: Listen to a short story about a child walking to school. Then tell a friend one thing that happened.

Example 3: Write three sentences about your school using new words from this lesson.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Polite language.
2. Explain Polite language to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Polite language.
4. Show that you can: Use appropriate vocabulary when making requests at home and at school.
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Polite language. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: Why is Polite language important to you?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 8: REMEMBER

1. Use appropriate vocabulary when making requests at home and at school.
2. Use appropriate vocabulary when appreciating others at home and at school.
3. Experience pleasure in making requests at home and at school.
4. Take pleasure in appreciating others when need arises. play making requests and appreciating others. deliberately model the habit of making requests and appreciating others as need arises. encouraged to make requests and appreciate others during 15 relevant situations in school and at home. clips on request and appreciation and be guided to imitate making requests and appreciation. Core-competence developed: Digital literacy, communication and collaboration,
